Name: Noospheric Data-Tether
Effect: Required to perceive and utilise the noosphere. Connects to the Tech-Adept’s Cyber Mantle and Cranial Circuitry. Connecting to a noosphere takes an action and a successful Challenging (+0) Discipline (Composure) Test; on failure, you can try again on a subsequent turn.

Name: Achillan Eye
Effect: Targets you shoot do not benefit from Cover unless entirely obscured. You may reroll Severity Rolls when you score a Critical Hit.

Name: Antigrav Core
Effect: Hover 1–2 metres above the ground, ignore Difficult Terrain, and gain +2 SL on Athletics (Climbing) Tests, even when not levitating.

Name: Autosanguine Implant
Effect: Recover from Bleeding one round after receiving it. Advantage on Fortitude Tests against contamination of your blood. Recover 1 Wound per day while active.

Name: Binary Cortex
Effect: A second brain always Helps on Intelligence-based Skill Tests in which it had an Advance. A Fumble on such a Test Stuns the bearer for one round. Typical Intelligence 40, six Specialisation Advances. A head Critical Wound has a 25% chance of hitting this brain; Rattling Blow, Laceration, Concussive Blow and Shattered Skull destroy it.

Name: Cranial Circuitry
Effect: Processors and cortical implants provide the framework and connectivity for further cerebral augmetics. An initiation augmetic; does not count towards the augmetic limit.

Name: Cyber Mantle
Effect: Spinal extension of cranial circuitry anchors body augmetics and connects manipulators and sensor units to the brain. An initiation augmetic; does not count towards the augmetic limit.

Name: Electoos
Effect: Subdermal synthetic inks reveal identification or patterns in response to electrical current, ultraviolet light or impact. An initiation augmetic; does not count towards the augmetic limit.

Name: Electro-Grafts
Effect: Subdermal sensors, ports and cabling sense electrical currents and facilitate communion with devices. An initiation augmetic; does not count towards the augmetic limit.

Name: Potentia Coils
Effect: Energy-storing coils power other augmetics and can connect to weapon systems. Keep them charged. An initiation augmetic; does not count towards the augmetic limit.

Name: Battle-sphere Uplink
Effect: With access to the battle-sphere, perceive troop movements, status, known enemy positions and maps. Advantage on Awareness, Intuition (Surroundings), Logic (Investigation) and Navigation (Surface, Tracking, Void) Tests involving that information.

Name: Data-Tether
Effect: A basic data connection that always requires physical interaction with a control unit or cogitator.

Name: Dataspike
Effect: Advantage on Tech Tests to overwrite or access a machine’s functions and memories, or bypass security measures.

Name: Electoo Matrix
Effect: Sense electrical devices and living creatures’ bioelectric signals within Short Range. While Blinded, no Disadvantage on Melee and Dodge (Reflexes) Tests.

Name: Eye of Serberys
Effect: Reduce Armour from other characters providing a target Cover by 3. After an Aim or Search Action against a target, gain Advantage on tracking them unless you lose sight of them for more than a few minutes.

Name: Incense Exhaust
Effect: As an Action, fill your Zone with holy smog, making it Lightly Obscured. Continuing or stopping emission needs no action. Smog clears 1d5 rounds after deactivation.

Name: Injector Rig
Effect: Contains five doses each of FZ-392, SL-203, SM-163 and DT-474; inject yourself or a subject within Immediate Range as a Free Action. Refill: 150 solars per dose, Scarce. Mixing chems causes Poisoned (Minor) until both wear off. A Critical Wound has a 20% chance of damaging the rig, causing Poisoned (Major) for 1d5 rounds.

Name: Mechadendrite Hive
Effect: Holds up to four mechadendrites, purchased separately, counting as one augmetic. With at least two functional limbs free to attack, use the Eviscerator melee profile.

Name: Mechadendrite Stabilisers
Effect: Ignore Disadvantage from void environmental effects, such as rocking or zero gravity. As an Action, adhere to ferromagnetic surfaces, ignoring zero or low gravity. In normal gravity, Challenging (+0) Athletics (Climbing) or Reflexes (Acrobatics) allows moving on metallic walls and ceilings or anchoring there.

Name: Rite of Pure Thought
Effect: Immune to Frightened. Advantage on Logic and Discipline (Composure) Tests; Disadvantage on Rapport (Charm). Removes emotional responses and creative thought; roleplaying consequences apply.

Name: Sanctus Canister
Effect: Advantage on Presence Tests to affect, inspire or command Adeptus Mechanicus members. Extends natural lifespan by d5 + 2 decades while installed and active.

Name: Secutor-Class Blade Implant
Effect: Always armed with a retractable Knife with Subtle and Penetrating (2), without Thrown (Short).

Name: Sicarian Pattern Legs
Effect: Installed only as a pair; listed price is for both and they occupy two augmetic slots. +1 Armour on each leg, +1 SL on Strength-based Tests using the pair, ignore Difficult Terrain.

Name: Vanguard Radium Core
Effect: Non-Adeptus Mechanicus characters sharing your Zone become Poisoned (Minor). Does not stack with other Vanguard Radium Cores or NPC Rad-saturation.

Name: Voltagheist Blast Unit
Effect: As an Action, spend Motive Force Charges: each deals 1 Damage ignoring Armour to every other character within Short Range. They may spend a Reaction to dodge as against a grenade blast.

Name: Voltagheist Field
Effect: Spend a Reaction and Motive Force Charges to gain +1 Armour per charge against that attack. After a successful attack with Electrostatic Gauntlets or an Electroleech Stave, gain +2 Armour per charge instead until the beginning of your next turn.

Name: Weapon Arm
Effect: Replace an arm with a weapon, bought separately. Its Encumbrance and Heavy rating still apply. Advantage on attacks and tasks with that weapon. Cannot wield other two-handed weapons; two-handed tasks may have Disadvantage. A weapon using your Potentia Coil that drains power or reloads requires a Routine (+20) Fortitude (Endurance) Test to avoid Fatigued (Minor).
